summary: Begins implementation of a backend built-in Gizmo Pi tool `display` for rendering json-render formatted chat content. Explored the workspace, reviewed the existing memory-journal extension registration pattern (fileURLToPath + additionalExtensionPaths), tool result transport via pi-event-translator and session-transcript, and the typebox/defineTool tool definition idiom. Started writing `apps/agent-server/src/pi-extensions/display.ts` with displayLimits constants and strict validator scaffolding against typebox Value.Check.
decisions: Tool will be defined via `defineTool` from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` with a TypeBox Object schema matching the contract: `{ title?: string, spec: { root: string, elements: Record<string, {type, props, children?}> } }`.
Registration will reuse the `additionalExtensionPaths` mechanism used for memory-journal (a `journalExtensionPath`-style helper appended to `piExtensions` in pi-session-factory).

Output will set Pi `details: { gizmoDisplay: { version: 1, title?, spec } }` so the existing tool-result transport (tool_execution_end → session-transcript `details` field) carries the payload; text will be a short summary, not the full spec.

Errors are thrown as normal tool errors (not display payloads) and validated against a static, bounded tree: missing children, cycles, unreachable nodes, total UTF-8 byte cap, and reasonable element counts.
May create `packages/protocol/src/display.ts` (re-exported from protocol index) to share parser/types/constants with the frontend; transcript notes this shared file will be owned by the task.
Work is constrained to backend and backend tests only; no frontend or shared-package edits beyond the optional new protocol file.
